Project-id URL encoding and API response handling verified safe

findings.title: getModelsForCurrentChat called unconditionally on projectId change
findings.problem: currentChat exists but projectId is null/undefined; getModelsForCurrentChat() called without guard, possible API error or stale state in chatsStore.filteredModels
findings.impact: Non-project chat triggers getModelsForCurrentChat() unnecessarily; API call fails silently or filteredModels becomes stale and out-of-sync with actual model list
findings.recommendation: Guard with if (!currentChat?.projectId) return before calling getModelsForCurrentChat()

findings.title: Project model fetch may fail without error handling
findings.problem: getLLMModels(projectId).then() without .catch(); if fetch fails, projectModels stays empty array, falls through to globalModels
findings.impact: API failure silently defeats project-scoped filtering; user sees all models instead of project-allowed subset
findings.recommendation: Add .catch() handler to log error and fall back to global models, or retry with exponential backoff

findings.title: Stale projectId when dependency updates race
findings.problem: currentChat.projectId changes rapidly or becomes null during dependency updates; filteredModels may not refresh in lockstep, causing mismatch between selector state and store
findings.impact: Switching projects rapidly shows stale model lists; wrong models displayed briefly or selector receives projectId that doesn't match loaded models
findings.recommendation: Use a dedicated useEffect with currentChat?.projectId in dependency list, and clear projectModels synchronously before fetching new ones

findings.title: defaultModel may be null if filtered list is empty
findings.problem: filteredModels.length > 0 but contains no isDefault model; modelsToDisplay computed from empty set; defaultModel lookup fails
findings.impact: Dropdown renders nothing when filtered models lack a default; UI breaks when all available models are filtered out and none has isDefault flag
findings.recommendation: Check if filtered list is empty and fall back to first global model, or show a 'no models available' message

findings.title: Conversation interface projectId field requires spec clarification
findings.problem: projectId is optional on Conversation; unclear if null/undefined means 'no project restriction' or 'legacy chat'; affects filtering logic interpretation
findings.impact: Ambiguous intent makes filtering logic error-prone; code may interpret missing projectId incorrectly (treat as unrestricted vs. invalid)
findings.recommendation: Document in spec whether projectId absence means 'unrestricted' or 'invalid'; ensure backend API contract clarifies the distinction

findings.title: useParams returns undefined projectName; defaults to 'demo'
findings.problem: projectName derived from useParams but may be undefined; component silently defaults to 'demo' project config, polluting wrong project when URL param missing
findings.impact: Model settings applied to 'demo' project if route param missing; user loses settings for actual project or corrupts demo project config
findings.recommendation: Validate projectName early; throw error or redirect if missing instead of silently defaulting to 'demo'

findings.title: All models marked disabled when no backend restrictions exist
findings.problem: storedEnabledModelIds.size === 0 AND initialSettings computed from empty set; all models marked 'disabled'; defaultModel logic fails; firstDefault empty string
findings.impact: Apply button becomes disabled; user cannot proceed with saving config; UI state inconsistent with expectations (unrestricted should allow selecting models)
findings.recommendation: Distinguish between 'no restrictions stored' (all models should default to enabled) vs 'restrictions exist but none enabled' (all disabled is valid)

findings.title: saveChanges() failure not validated before navigation
findings.problem: saveChanges() returns false on validation failure but applyChangesAndNavigate proceeds to router.push() regardless; unsaved state navigated away
findings.impact: User loses unsaved model configuration changes; change appears to complete but was never persisted
findings.recommendation: Check saveChanges() return value in applyChangesAndNavigate; only proceed to navigate if save succeeds

findings.title: useBlocker never shows navigation prompt on unsaved changes
findings.problem: blocker.reset() or blocker.proceed() called when blocker.state is not 'blocked'; state machine deadlock possible; dialog never shows on back/route-change
findings.impact: User can navigate away and lose unsaved model configuration without warning; no confirmation dialog shown
findings.recommendation: Check blocker.state === 'blocked' before calling reset/proceed; ensure dialog visibility toggle syncs with blocker state

findings.title: Disabling current default model leaves defaultIsValid false; Apply button stuck disabled
findings.problem: setModelEnabled(model, false) when model === projectDefault; projectDefault set to empty string; defaultIsValid check now false; UI not updated; Apply button becomes disabled
findings.impact: User disables the default model, Apply button disables permanently; user cannot save the config even though selection is valid
findings.recommendation: After setting model disabled, auto-select next enabled model as default, or trigger UI update immediately to show new default

findings.title: Failed backend fetch treated as 'no restrictions' instead of error
findings.problem: getProjectModelConfigurationFromBackend() returns null on API error; null config interpreted as 'unrestricted'; filtering bypassed completely
findings.impact: Network error or 404 silently enables all models regardless of backend policy; project restrictions effectively disappear on fetch failure
findings.recommendation: Distinguish between 'no restrictions' (explicit policy) and 'fetch failed' (error); show error to user or retry

findings.title: Empty array semantic ambiguity: disabled vs. unrestricted
findings.problem: allowed_models undefined falls back to []; empty array may mean 'all disabled' or 'no restrictions'; semantic inversion possible depending on interpretation
findings.impact: Code that reads allowed_models may filter incorrectly; empty array could disable all models when intent is unrestricted
findings.recommendation: Document backend contract: is allowed_models: [] ever used? If so, clarify meaning; consider using null for 'unrestricted'

findings.title: API failure retry loop may cause infinite calls if models change
findings.problem: loadModels useEffect depends on currentAllowedModels; if API fails and currentAllowedModels changes (due to user selection), loadModels runs again; infinite retry loop possible
findings.impact: Excessive API calls; toaster spam; performance degradation; user experience broken by repeated failed requests
findings.recommendation: Use a separate loading state and retry counter; break retry loop after N attempts or use exponential backoff

findings.title: Uncaught JSON parse error during model mapping
findings.problem: chatResp.json() or imageResp.json() throws; mapped models may be partially initialized; uncaught promise rejection
findings.impact: Component unmounts; UI breaks if JSON parsing fails; no error boundary catches the rejection
findings.recommendation: Wrap .json() calls in try-catch; handle parse errors explicitly

findings.title: Empty model list validation silent on no available models
findings.problem: currentAllowedModels null (means all allowed) but chatData/imageData empty arrays; allModels.length === 0; selectedModels empty Set; saving validation fails
findings.impact: UI appears functional but save fails silently; user cannot proceed; no error message explaining why models list is empty
findings.recommendation: Show explicit error 'No models available for this project' when allModels.length === 0

findings.title: Validation fails with confusing message when API response empty
findings.problem: validateSelection() called when chatModels.length === 0 from failed API; returns false with 'No chat models available' instead of 'API failed to load models'
findings.impact: User sees confusing error message; cannot distinguish between 'no models exist' and 'failed to load models'
findings.recommendation: Clarify validation error message to distinguish API failure from legitimate 'no models' scenario

findings.title: Invalid model selection accepted without validation
findings.problem: onDefaultChange called with modelId not in models array; state becomes inconsistent; radio button shows checked but model doesn't exist
findings.impact: UI state mismatched to data model; saving invalid default model may fail on backend or corrupt project config
findings.recommendation: Validate modelId against models array before updating; reject or show error if invalid

findings.title: updateAllowedModels method missing or unimplemented
findings.problem: updateAllowedModels() called but method may not exist or endpoint 404s; error toasted but UI state not rolled back
findings.impact: Save fails; user thinks change was applied but it was not; project config left in invalid state
findings.recommendation: Verify updateAllowedModels exists in projects store; add error handling to roll back UI state on failure

findings.title: Navigation failure not caught; Models tab click may fail silently
findings.problem: router.push() called without try-catch; route name may not exist; error thrown but not caught
findings.impact: User clicks Models tab but navigation fails; page does not update; user confused about state
findings.recommendation: Add try-catch around router.push() or use route validation before push

findings.title: ActiveTab defaults to overview when route unknown
findings.problem: getActiveTab(router.name) receives undefined or unknown route name; defaults to 'overview'; tab navigation broken
findings.impact: Models tab displays overview tab content; navigation between project detail tabs broken
findings.recommendation: Validate router.name against known routes; show error or redirect if route unknown
